subject.title: fix(plugins): bound hosted catalog feed reads on non-streaming responses

question: Should hosted catalog refresh fail closed to snapshot or bundled fallback when Fetch returns a streamless `Response.body`?
rationale: The patch closes a memory-safety hole, but it intentionally trades hosted-feed availability for safety in non-streaming fetch environments.

options.title: Accept fail-closed fallback
options.body: Land after real behavior proof, accepting snapshot or bundled fallback rather than risking unbounded allocation from an untrusted hosted feed.

options.title: Require bounded streamless support
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a design that bounds streamless bodies without trusting headers or buffering the full response.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed fallback
recommendation.body: Land after real behavior proof, accepting snapshot or bundled fallback rather than risking unbounded allocation from an untrusted hosted feed.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the hosted feed loader and fallback contract being changed.
